verdict.rationale: Google Voice's own admin docs describe a real bulk operation: a single port request can take up to 1000 phone numbers, entered comma-separated or as a number range (docs-9). Several ports can also run at the same time (docs-12), and a downloadable template captures port-order details (docs-13). This sits under a general claim of managing numbers 'at scale' (docs-1), but the evidenced bulk capability is confined to number porting. missing for 10: bulk operations beyond porting (e.g., mass number assignment, license or settings changes across many users), a programmatic or API-driven bulk interface suited to AI-native automation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
